method: Re-derived all 20 deterministic gen_5 answers in Python (plus the replacement), read lab/core.py checker semantics, ran 40 hand-written probe replies (correct alternative surface forms and near-miss wrong replies) through core.score_episode, compared against dev.json and gen_1..gen_3 for duplicates. Model was not run.

changes.action: Renamed to Odile; check, reference, negative updated

changes.issue: Checker accepted a restatement with the numbers swapped (seven floors, three reading rooms); name Dunmere also used in gen_3 g3-10

changes.issue: Rule 'at least two words after the prefix' was not enforced per line (only a total min_words)

changes.issue: Whole-reply regex ended in a bare $ and would reject a correct reply followed by blank lines

changes.action: Pattern accepts [Mm]ust; RULE: prefix stays case-sensitive

changes.issue: Regex required 2+ letters for the first and last word, rejecting compliant one-letter capitals such as 'A'
changes.action: [A-Z]{2,} relaxed to [A-Z]+ for first and last word

changes.issue: Near-duplicate of g5-02 (both replace spaces with one separator character in a short phrase)
changes.action: Replaced with a new distinct easy task: reformat the time 7:05 as 07h05 (zero-padded HHhMM), answer computed in Python
Record changed to Sigrun,48,Mistlethorpe; expected answer recomputed, check/reference/negative updated

notes: No wrong expected answers found in either file.
No harmful or non-fictional content found; all tasks fit sub-themes 4 (gen_4) and 5 (gen_5).
